# Why

<!--
Please describe the motivation for this PR, and link to relevant GitHub issues, forums posts, or feature requests.
-->

https://github.com/expo/expo/issues/37972

# How

<!--
How did you build this feature or fix this bug and why?
-->

This PR adds a short delay after the event callback is called to prevent a race condition described in the [Android documentation](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/net/ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback#onAvailable(android.net.Network)).

Both [react-native-netinfo](https://github.com/react-native-netinfo/react-native-netinfo/blob/c5a93fb91f9de51f2d9ae37faffe49f04e0dd4a4/android/src/main/java/com/reactnativecommunity/netinfo/NetworkCallbackConnectivityReceiver.java#L170)￼ and the [Flutter library](https://github.com/fluttercommunity/plus_plugins/blob/61786a1d680d8c3886b4fceb34d689ec94e10d8a/packages/connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus/android/src/main/java/dev/fluttercommunity/plus/connectivity/ConnectivityBroadcastReceiver.java#L74)￼ apply a similar approach.

# Test Plan

<!--
Please describe how you tested this change and how a reviewer could reproduce your test, especially if this PR does not include automated tests! If possible, please also provide terminal output and/or screenshots demonstrating your test/reproduction.
-->

1. Toggle the network connection on and off multiple times.
2. Verify that the correct network state is always reported.
